Class LoadInstruction

java.lang.Object
aslframework.ui.LoadInstruction
public class LoadInstruction extends Object
Encapsulates the instruction video player for the ASL learning platform.

Manages loading, playing, and replaying per-letter MP4 instruction videos stored at assets/guidance/<letter>.mp4. Exposes a StackPane that can be embedded directly into the instruction panel of GameUI.

Usage: 

LoadInstruction loader = new LoadInstruction(VIDEO_DIR);
instructionPane.getChildren().add(0, loader.getView());
loader.load("A");   // call whenever the target letter changes
loader.dispose();   // call on window close

    • setFixedSize

      public void setFixedSize(double width, double height)
      Sets fixed pixel dimensions for the video container and MediaView. Call once after the scene is shown to lock in the size with no animation.
      Parameters:
      width - fixed width in pixels
      height - fixed height in pixels

    • load

      public void load(String letter)
      Loads and immediately plays the instruction video for the given letter. Disposes the previous MediaPlayer before loading the new one.
      Parameters:
      letter - the ASL letter to show (e.g. "A")

    • replay

      public void replay()
      Seeks to the beginning and replays the current video. Called by the replay button and can also be called programmatically.

    • dispose

      public void dispose()
      Stops playback and releases all media resources. Must be called when the owning window is closed.
